newsitem.title: POLAND: BANK HANDLOWY TO UNDERWRITE BYTOM ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: BANK HANDLOWY TO UNDERWRITE BYTOM ISSUE.

text.p: The brokerage unit of Polish ~Bank Handlowy SA~ will underwrite all the shares of the forthcoming 250,000-share issue of garment maker Bytom SA, Bytom said in a statement on Tuesday.
It said the stand-by fee would be five percent of the value of the underwritten shares and that Handlowy would receive an additional 13-percent discount if it bought the shares.
Handlowy had previously said it would organise an underwriting consortium.
The ex-rights issue, priced at 27 zlotys per share and already cleared by the Polish Securities Commission, will increase the company's share capital by half from the present 500,000 shares.
The large-investor 150,000-share tranche is scheduled from October 2 to October 4 and the small-investor tranche of 100,000 shares is set for between October 2 and October 9.
Large investors can register for 5,000 to 150,000 shares. The company plans to use 60 percent of the funds raised by the issue to boost its working capital.
The remaining 40 percent would be spent on upgrading the company's several production facilities.
